At this dismal intelligence, I twisted the only button on my waistcoat round and ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"over"** means extending directly upward from. (ऊपर से)

 
 
• **Example: **He watched **over** his little brother as he played.
 
 
 
• **"round" **refers to moving in a circular direction or position. (गोल)
 
 
• **Example: **She turned** round** to see who was calling her name.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word in the sentence is **'round'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **up On** (ऊपर): In or into a higher position.

 
 
• **Example:** He climbed up on the roof to fix the leak.
 
 
 
• **over **(ऊपर से): Extending directly upward from.
 
 
• **Example: **He watched over his little brother as he played.
 
 
 
• **around** (आसपास): In or to various places within a particular area.
 
 
• **Example:** He looked around the room to find his keys.
